run_1.description: Business Impact: Potential unauthorized access to internal systems due to reliance on single authentication factor. | Missing Requirements: Formal documented policy defining authentication requirements (e.g., mandatory MFA, password complexity, lockout thresholds).

run_2.description: Business Impact: Potential unauthorized access to internal systems due to reliance solely on Active Directory credentials without explicit MFA enforcement. | Missing Requirements: Explicit documentation of the authentication configuration, specifically confirming the implementation and configuration of Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).
